gate_4.name: Adapter Attachment & Empirical Gradient Verification
gate_4.summary_sentence: All 192 adaptable linear modules (global_attention: 96, ffn: 72, ssm: 24) achieved GRADIENT_OK, and the negative control on conv1d correctly confirmed an inert adapter target (48/48 GRADIENT_MISSING).

negative_control.headline_sentence: The negative control DID correctly detect an inert adapter target.
negative_control.mechanism: causal_conv1d_fn in FalconH1Mixer uses raw self.conv1d.weight directly, completely bypassing the LoRA wrapped forward pass.
